en.t: The young lady spread out the small parcel.

units.source_text: 柏木说过不用备盒饭，果然不假。

en.t: Kashiwagi had said there was no need to prepare boxed lunches, and sure enough, that was true.

units.source_text: 摊开的包裹上有四份三明治、难以弄到手的舶来点心，还有只供占领军用的。

en.t: On the opened parcel were four servings of sandwiches, hard to obtain imported sweets, and even things meant only for the Occupation forces.

units.source_text: 靠黑市才能买到的三得利威士忌。

en.t: There was Suntory whisky that could only be bought on the black market.

units.source_text: 据说，京都是京饭神地方的黑市买卖的中心地。

en.t: It was said that Kyoto was the center of black market trade in the Kyoto Osaka Kobe region.
